title: SWOT Explorer (source code)
description:
Source code of SWOT Explorer, a browser extension for Chrome and Edge that searches, previews, clips and downloads Surface Water and Ocean Topography (SWOT) satellite hydrology data and builds quality-controlled water level, area and storage time series.

This record archives software only. It is not a paper, preprint or manuscript. Any paper that describes SWOT Explorer is published separately and cites this record as its software archive.
